how_to_apply: Use the prescribed application format attached to the advertisement, printed or typed on A-4 paper.
Fill all entries in handwriting, sign at the marked place and paste a recent passport-size colour photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of the certificates and the medical certificate.
Seal the form in an envelope with your full name and address and write 'Application for the post of Assistant Grade-3 or Peon' on it.
Send by registered post or submit in person to the Personnel Department, Second Floor, Panchanan Bhawan, Bhopal.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPLUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MPLUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 4 Assistant Grade-3, 6 Peon (Class IV).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MPLUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application format attached with the advertisement (pages 5-7); also on http://mplun.mpmsme.gov.in and https://sparsh.mp.gov.in/SJMIS/Public/Home.aspx) and send it to Managing Director, M.P. Laghu Udyog Nigam Maryadit, Personnel Department, Second Floor, Panchanan Bhawan, T.T. Nagar, Bhopal, by registered post or in person, to reach by 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 45 years; maximum age limit not more than 45 years for any category including all (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: Maximum age limit 45 years in any case for any category, including all relaxations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level-4 (Rs. 5200-20200+1900 Grade Pay) for Assistant Grade-3, Level-1 (Rs. 4440-7440+1300 Grade Pay) for Peon (Class IV).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assistant Grade-3: 10+2 passed from Madhyamik Shiksha Mandal board, CPCT passed, knowledge of Computer Application/Internet/Browsing Surfing compulsory. Peon (Class IV): 8th passed. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only divyangjan (persons with disabilities) candidates may apply. Applicant must be a native (domicile) of Madhya Pradesh. Applicant must have live registration in any employment office of Madhya Pradesh. Joining only if disability is found to be 40 percent or more.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who appeared in the final year exam of the prescribed qualification but whose result is not declared by the date of application. Government/semi-government employees applying directly instead of through the appointing officer.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the minimum educational qualification prescribed for the post. Merit list on the basis of marks in the minimum prescribed educational qualification. Selected candidates undergo medical examination by district-level medical board before appointment order.
